records.text: She did not heed a voice or accept discipline; she did not trust the Lord or approach her God.
And you will say this word to them: This is the nation that did not hear the Lord’s voice or accept instruction; faithfulness failed from their mouth.

triples.relationship: refusal to hear the Lord and accept instruction
triples.rationale: Zephaniah says the city did not heed a voice or accept discipline; Jeremiah's native composite unit names a nation that did not hear the Lord's voice or accept instruction. The matched refusal of hearing and correction is explicit in both; the composite target is preserved as one source-edition unit.
